title: Fundamentals first, then most of the time on practice
takeaway: Reading is not practising; six weeks build the concepts and the final six are repetition and feedback out loud.
sources: The most common mistake developers make is reading about system design without practicing it.
The final phase is the most important: repetition and feedback.
